purpose: The ten families whose official source bytes cannot be produced by custody work, with what each one actually needs. These are not acquisition tasks custody can complete; eight have no member matching their pinned digest in any accessible corpus, and two have never had a digest recorded at all.
custodyPositionOnRepinning: Custody will not re-pin a digest to make a family resolvable. A digest that is changed to fit an available file stops being evidence of anything. Both no_digest_ever_recorded families need an authorised first pin from a named publisher retrieval, not a hash of the nearest candidate.

families.rootBlocker: official source bytes are not present in any accessible corpus
families.whatSession1MustSupply: the official publisher bytes for this exact digest, or an authorised decision that the pinned digest is wrong and a re-pin is permitted
families.whatCustodyMustNotDo: substitute a same-named file. A filename, a path convention or a manifest claim is not a match; only the digest is.
